plain.li: Won't be long.
Mind your backs, I'm carrying.
I've an errand to see to first.
[give] {OTHER_nameDef} should have this today, not tomorrow.
[give] If anyone sees {OTHER_nameDef}, don't say a word.
[burn] Somebody clear a spot in the yard.
[burn] Keep the door open, I'm carrying this straight through.
[fetch] Our visitor says it's ready, so I'll go and fetch it.

warm.li: I'll be back before you miss me.
[fetch] I'll thank our visitor while I'm over there.
[burn] Better on the fire than causing any more grief.

blunt.li: Out of my way, I'm carrying.
[fetch] Going to get it, back soon.

cheerful.li: [give] {OTHER_nameDef} is going to be so surprised.
[burn] There'll be a fire in the yard in a minute, a small one.
[fetch] Our visitor's made something, and I get to see it first.

gloomy.li: [give] {OTHER_nameDef} will probably put it in a chest and forget it.
[burn] We should have burned it the day we found it.

cold.li: [burn] Taking it out to be destroyed.

plain.li: That's that seen to.
Mind where you step.
[give] Don't say anything yet, just look at it.
[give] I've had this set aside for you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[burn] Let it burn right down, then we'll rake it over.
[burn] Keep the smoke out of your eyes.
[fetch] I'll set it down here where everyone can see it.
[fetch] Our visitor does fine work, I'll say that.

warm.li: [give] This is for all the times you helped me, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[give] Keep it somewhere you'll see it every day.

cheerful.li: That went better than I expected.
[give] No reason, {OTHER_nameDef}, I just wanted you to have it.
[fetch] Look what our visitor made for us!

gloomy.li: [give] You don't have to like it, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[burn] There goes a good few days' trouble, up in smoke.

cold.li: [give] It's yours now, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I've no further use for it.
[burn] Make sure every bit of it burns.

plain.li: Nearest first, and I'll work my way round.
[outdoors] Bowls out, I'm coming round with the pot.
[outdoors] Whoever's working outside, the pot's on its way.

warm.li: I'll see every one of you before the day's out.

blunt.li: [outdoors] Pot's coming, so don't wander off.

cheerful.li: I'll get round to every one of you, I promise.
[outdoors] Soup on legs, coming your way.

gloomy.li: This'll take the rest of the day.
[outdoors] It'll be cold before I reach the last of you.

cold.li: [outdoors] Meals for the outside workers, nearest first.

plain.li: There you are, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Just a moment of your time, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[outdoors] Take a bowl, the pot's still warm.

warm.li: You're looking better than last time, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[outdoors] Sit down a minute and eat, {OTHER_nameDef}, the work will keep.

blunt.li: Stand still, {OTHER_nameDef}, this won't take long.
[outdoors] Bowl, quick, I've others to get to.

cheerful.li: Your turn, {OTHER_nameDef}, and you've been very patient.
[outdoors] Hot soup for the hardest worker out here.

gloomy.li: Don't mind me, I'll be gone in a moment.
[outdoors] There's not much in it, but drink it while it's hot.

cold.li: Stay where you are, {OTHER_nameDef}, this is quick.
[outdoors] Eat it now, I'll need the bowl back.

plain.li: Two to a body, and lift with your legs.
Let's get them out before the flies find them.
[pyre] Pile the wood high, it has to burn a long time.
[graves] Someone fetch the shovels, it'll be a long dig.

warm.li: Let's do this decently, whoever they were.
[graves] They tried to kill us, and they still get a grave.

blunt.li: Grab the feet, I'll take the arms.
Cloth over your nose and get on with it.

cheerful.li: The faster we work, the sooner we wash.
Come on, it's a nasty job but it's a short one.

gloomy.li: I'll be dreaming about this tonight.
Somebody's waiting for these ones to come home.

cold.li: Take one each and come back for the next.
The sooner they're gone, the sooner the place is clean.

plain.li: Watch the step here.
Put it down a moment, my grip's going.
[pyre] Higher up the pile, it'll burn better.
[treeline] Far enough, the animals will do the rest.
[trench] Straighten that one, there's more to fit in.

cheerful.li: Nearly done, then it's a wash and a hot meal.

gloomy.li: This one was younger than me.
Same as the last one, and the one before.

cold.li: That one's done, go back for another.

plain.li: Sit down, all of you, please.
I've kept something from you, and I'm done keeping it.

warm.li: You're the people I trust most, so you should hear this.
Please hear me out to the end.

cheerful.li: Don't panic, but I have news about myself.

gloomy.li: I've put this off long enough.
There's no good way to say this.

cold.li: Listen carefully, I'll only say it once.
You'll want to hear this from me before you hear it from anyone else.
